ℹ️ MODEL DESCRIPTION

Orb Analytics uses an ensemble of three machine learning models (Logistic Regression, Linear Regression, Random Forest) to predict NBA game outcomes. Each day, the models are retrained on all historical data and dynamically select the top 15 most predictive features using Lasso regression.

Predictions are standardized by blending 35% model output with 65% market implied probability to balance statistical signals with market efficiency. We only bet when our edge exceeds 3%, ensuring disciplined bankroll management.
